verdict.rationale: A government online-filing service could plausibly offer API access, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no API credential system at all: no OpenAPI spec was found, the tax portal starts from a business entity file number rather than an account, and it is gated by an image CAPTCHA. Nothing documents scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
